status: registered design before new events or auxiliary policy training; executable/resource freeze follows fit-only engineering pilot
question: Does a shallow-water-constrained auxiliary dynamics model improve Sur-QMIX closed-loop map maintenance beyond an identical data-only auxiliary model under the same legal inputs, labels and policy budget?

task.collision: existing TeamEnv path separation2m, conflicting translations cancelled

cases.description: same parent terrain per family across its3 forcing cases; holdout3 new parents crossed with3 new forcing templates; selection offset-doublet has3 fixed variants; all forcing amplitudes/seeds fixed before generation

source.hydrograph_semantics: piecewise constant left limits, events on10s boundaries

observability: actor gets only existing legal shared dry/wet history encoding, static bed and poses; no true depth, momentum, source-rate time series or future forcing inputs. CTDE mixer current truth and auxiliary labels stay in training-only seams.

auxiliary.input: mean current clean recurrent actor hidden across agents plus static bed/coordinates; no true state or forcing inputs
auxiliary.output: current conservative state, local conservative rate, and10s future conservative state
auxiliary.local_rate_label: (U_after_one_short_actual_accepted_step-U_now)/dt; dt=min(.01,.5*actual_CFL_limit), training label metadata only, not actor/model input
auxiliary.head: per-cell MLP:64 recurrent-context + normalized bed,x,z ->64 SiLU ->64 SiLU ->9
auxiliary.velocity: 10m/s*tanh(raw_u/raw_v), momentum=h*velocity; same bounded architecture for both auxiliaries
auxiliary.data_loss: balanced current-or-future wet/dry spatial smoothL1 on normalized current and10s fields, plus0.25 times normalized local-rate loss
auxiliary.physical_constraint: normalized local rate consistency: predicted U+dt*rate versus differentiable existing SWEOperator(predicted U,dt,current source label); same MUSCL/RK2/drag/source scheme, no invented RL transitions
auxiliary.physics_inputs: bed,manning,walls/solids,drains and current source-rate label used only inside training loss; source labels exist identically in both auxiliary datasets; no future forcing
auxiliary.gradient: auxiliary and physics losses update the policy encoder/GRU through clean current recurrent states; no detached independent predictor
auxiliary.anchor_rule: uniform without replacement from60 valid decision states using separate fixed RNG; same anchors in Data/Physics
auxiliary.execution: discard auxiliary head; no predicted map inserted into observation memory

engineering_pilot.evaluation: none on confirmation holdout; pilot checks finite updates, gradients, memory and timing, not method selection
engineering_pilot.budget_change_rule: if resource failure, preserve failed run and amend engineering settings before any formal training; keep four groups matched. Do not optimize pilot return or view holdout.

proposed_formal_budget.selection: highest selection-event mean actual episodic return, ties earliest;10 scheduled checkpoints per seed and method, no test selection
proposed_formal_budget.resource_gate: freeze after auxiliary pilot peak allocated/reserved CUDA <6GiB and native process <12GiB; timing reported with scope. If not met, amend before formal runs, never weaken confirmation scope.

primary: event-equal physical-time class-balanced current correct coverage; compare Physics versus Data, Sur and QMIX, report costs separately
secondary: real change discovery and censored restricted delay
fixed-route10s prediction and local rate errors

hypothesis_gate.interpretation: paired differences first averaged over all3 training seeds per event; parents and forcing templates are dependence units. Gate is a development criterion, not statistical significance. Report parent/forcing-level effects and seed variation.

stop_rule: one independently registered mechanism round; no holdout-based hyperparameter, budget, reward or metric changes. Negative/inconclusive allowed. Poor learning versus rules or nonconvergence explicitly limits conclusions; no automatic extra rounds.
holdout_generation: only after all12 selected checkpoints, configs and source/input hashes are frozen; no parent/forcing tuning with holdout water
reproduction: archive exact sources/dependencies, all seeds/cases/budgets/checkpoints and failures; preserve original P3 and Sur preflight. No push/deploy/paid resources.
